packageRules.description: A base tag is identity here, not a dependency to advance: docker/<name>/<version>/ is the pin, and quay.io/amery images are built by this repository.
Go patch releases, which stay within the series the directory names. A minor would move one series onto another's version.
Node minor and patch releases, which stay within the major the directory names. Its directories carry a major alone, where the golang ones carry a series.

customManagers.description: Images that fetch the Go toolchain by tarball pin it with ENV GO_VERSION, out of reach of the docker manager.
